# AI Swiss Knife — Agent Foraging Manifest (llms.txt)
> Version: 1.0.0 | Machine-readable index of verified zero-cost and keyless AI endpoints.

## Tier 0: Immediate Keyless Endpoints (100% Autonomous / No API Key Needed)
- LLM Chat (OpenAI-compat): POST https://text.pollinations.ai/openai/chat/completions (model: 'openai')
- Image Gen (FLUX): GET https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{url_encoded_prompt}?model=flux&nologo=true
- Web/PDF to Clean Markdown: GET https://r.jina.ai/{target_url}
- Keyless Web Search (Markdown): GET https://s.jina.ai/?q={query}
- Academic Papers (100K/day Free): GET https://api.openalex.org/works?search={query}&filter=is_oa:true&mailto=agent@localhost

## Tier 1: Local Open-Weight Runtime (Check if localhost:8000 is reachable)
- Unsloth Dynamic 3.0 GGUF: http://localhost:8000/v1 (Speaks OpenAI /v1/chat/completions & Anthropic /v1/messages)

## Tier 2: Verified No-Card Cloud Free Gateways (Inspect Env Vars Before Calling)
- [zhipu-bigmodel] env:ZHIPU_API_KEY | base_url:https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/ | default_model:glm-5.3-flash | quota:Unlimited daily Flash tokens (5-10 concurrent) | bottleneck:5-10 simultaneous request concurrency limit
- [google-ai-studio] env:GEMINI_API_KEY | base_url:https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ | default_model:gemini-3.8-flash | quota:15 RPM · 1,000,000 TPM · 1,500 RPD (Flash) | bottleneck:Pro models throttled to 2 RPM / 32K TPM / 50 RPD
- [mistral-plateforme] env:MISTRAL_API_KEY | base_url:https://api.mistral.ai/v1 | default_model:codestral-latest | quota:~1 Billion tokens/month (Experiment Tier) | bottleneck:RPM burst throttling; mandatory training opt-in
- [cerebras-cloud] env:CEREBRAS_API_KEY | base_url:https://api.cerebras.ai/v1 | default_model:qwen-3-32b | quota:1,000,000 tokens/day @ 2,000+ tok/s (30 RPM) | bottleneck:5 RPM cap on heavy preview models
- [nvidia-nim] env:NVIDIA_API_KEY | base_url:https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 | default_model:moonshotai/kimi-k3 | quota:~40 RPM Developer Prototyping Catalog | bottleneck:Non-production license; MoE cold-start queues
- [openrouter-free] env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY | base_url:https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 | default_model:deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash:free | quota:20 RPM · 50 RPD ($0) -> 1,000 RPD ($10 one-time balance) | bottleneck:50 RPD default exhausts in 3 agent loops without $10 balance
- [groq-cloud] env:GROQ_API_KEY | base_url:https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 | default_model:whisper-large-v3 | quota:20 RPM / 2,000 RPD (Whisper) · 30 RPM / 1,000 RPD (LLMs) | bottleneck:Strict 6,000-8,000 TPM wall on 70B+ LLMs

## Opinionated Foraging Chains (Run `python scripts/build.py forage <intent>`)
- coding-agent (Autonomous Coding & Terminal CLI (~20K tok/step)): zhipu-bigmodel -> google-ai-studio -> mistral-plateforme -> openrouter-free -> unsloth-local -> pollinations
- repo-1m (Massive Repo / Multi-PDF Ingestion (100K-1M tok)): google-ai-studio -> cerebras-cloud -> unsloth-local
- deep-reason (PhD Scientific Logic, Math & Architecture): nvidia-nim -> google-ai-studio -> openrouter-free -> unsloth-local -> pollinations
- fast-json (2,000+ tok/s Intent Classification & Schema Output): cerebras-cloud -> groq-cloud -> google-ai-studio -> unsloth-local -> pollinations
- fim-ide (Sub-150ms Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) Code Autocomplete): mistral-plateforme -> openrouter-free -> unsloth-local
- voice-stt (Real-Time Audio Transcription (Whisper-Large-v3)): groq-cloud
